title: Reservoir hard-gate resolution and interior-dam routing
objectives: lock immutable activation milestones for Longtan, Changzhou and Datengxia
separate development-fit eligibility from post-development operator eligibility
support a conserving interior-dam split for Baipenzhu Reach 17
resolve partial-domain reservoir representation without adding unobserved water
allowed_changes: reservoir activation dates and capacity-version selection
local-capture fraction for a registered interior dam
area-fraction scaling of storage-zone priors for a partial modeled catchment
forbidden_changes: use of 2019-2022 flow outcomes for parameter or structure selection
addition of unregistered lateral inflow to repair area mismatch
automatic authorization from nearest-Reach distance alone

activation_policy.storage_operator_start: first verified impoundment date when available; otherwise first verified operational milestone
activation_policy.before_activation: strict identity bypass with empty storage
activation_policy.post_2018_activation: operator may run with a locked hierarchical prior but is not eligible for reservoir-specific fitting

partial_domain_policy.interior_dam: capture all upstream routed water plus only the registered fraction of the control Reach local contribution
partial_domain_policy.partial_catchment: scale capacity and storage-zone priors by represented_area/official_control_area; retain routed modeled inflow unchanged
partial_domain_policy.claim_boundary: outputs represent the modeled fraction of the real reservoir system
